items.title: Saudi inflation Reaches 1.8% in August

The agreement was signed by Chief Executive Officer of Expo 2030 Riyadh Talal Al-Marri and Chief Executive Officer of Mohammad Al Habib Real Estate Company Abdullah Mohammad Al Habib, at the Expo 2030 Riyadh site, where development and construction works continue to advance at pace.
